name: kb_feral_cat_druid
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's feral cat list: Faerie Fire (Feral) on a new mob, Tiger's Fury kept up, Rake and Rip bleeding, Ferocious Bite at five points once Rip is up, Shred on Clearcasting and Claw as the filler. The prowl opener, Reshift and the bleed-immune exceptions are not expressible; the attack that starts the swing is queued first, as the KB's opener assumes white swings.

rows.text: Opener: Prowl -> Tiger's Fury (before an energy tick) -> Pounce -> Rake -> Rip -> Claw to 5 -> Ferocious Bite; no stealth: Faerie Fire (Feral) |
Tiger's Fury | buff (Blood Frenzy/TF) missing; off GCD
Rip | target bleedable AND Rip missing AND combo_points==5 (fight <30s: Rip at 1-3 CP)

entries.note: The KB's bleed-immunity and 'Rip at 1-3 points in a short fight' cases are creature properties the conditions cannot see; the entry takes five points.

rows.text: Ferocious Bite | combo_points==5 AND Rip up (Carnage refreshes Rip+Rake); on fast trash 4 CP ok; never <5 on bosses

entries.note: The KB's 4-point trash concession is not a condition; the list takes five points and Rip up (Carnage refreshes it).

rows.text: Rake | target bleedable AND Rake missing

entries.note: 'Bleedable' is a creature property, not a condition.
The KB's 'behind the target' is melee_position's business: the preset stands the cat behind the mob.
Attached to the filler row: a melee rotation has no white swings without it, and the KB's opener and Tiger's Fury rows assume them.

rows.text: Reshift | energy < 28-32 AND Tiger's Fury < 3 s left AND no energy tick imminent; recast TF after (Reshift drops TF)
